newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey shares fall 2.75 pct politics, short cash.
newsitem.headline: Turkey shares fall 2.75 pct politics, short cash.

text.p: Turkey's stock market index dived 2.75 percent on Friday on cash shortage due to weekend demand, public salary payments and political uneasiness ahead of next week's parliamentary votes on corruption charges, said brokers.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 ended 44 points down at 1,555. Volume was lower at 28.4 trillion lira vs Thursday's 34 trillion lira.
